findings.subject: empty support range
findings.evidence: scripts/lib/project-rag-corpus.mjs spanText requires safe integers and endByteExclusive > startByte. Added executable freeze-to-spanText regression passed on the original implementation.

findings.subject: review.actor can be fabricated
findings.evidence: freeze checks consistency of a trusted agent-authored input. Actual independent review is verified separately against saved provider prompt/result/terminal hashes. The full 27-question WorkBuddy review receipts remain on disk. No claim of cryptographic actor authentication is made.

findings.subject: short near-duplicate documents across families
findings.change: Use a full token sequence when a document has fewer than five tokens. Punctuation-only differences now share the same fingerprint and cannot cross source families.
findings.evidence: short-family-before.json and short-family-after.json; new positive-valid question data is included in the final regression.

findings.subject: sourceIds and familyId leak to tested generator
findings.evidence: The returned evaluation object is explicitly evaluator-only. questions-public-r1.json contains only id/question/locale/intent/split; all captured answer requests contain only question and DCS messages. Original source/family fields were not sent to generation.

receipts.output:
1) 高：freezeKnowledgeQuestions 未校验 support.quote 非空及 startByte<endByteExclusive。触发：answerable/conflicting 题提交零长度范围且 quote=""（start=end 在 ownerRange 内），spanText 返回空串即通过；影响：空证据/伪冲突进入 gold，字节封存失效。
2) 高：复核身份可伪造。review.datasetDigest 只哈希 families+questions，不含 review.actor、acceptedQuestionIds，且无签名；触发：作者自填不同 actor 字符串并把未审题加入 acceptedQuestionIds；影响：独立复核门可绕过/篡改。
3) 中：来源族近重复隔离有洞。shingles 为 5-gram，文档少于 5 词时 hashes 为空；触发：两短页仅标点不同跨族（如 alpha beta / alpha beta!），normalizedDigest 不同而 union 为空通过；影响：近重复源跨 split。
4) 中：gold 未完全隔离。queries 仅删 support/answerability，仍留 sourceIds/familyId；触发：生成器读取 queries 的 sourceIds 限定检索；影响：证据源泄漏，评测偏置。
FINAL=FAIL
